name: audiocpp_tts
description: Read the assistant's reply aloud using an audio.cpp server (/v1/audio/speech)
icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M11 5 6 9H2v6h4l5 4z'/><path d='M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07'/><path d='M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14'/></svg>

params.name: model
params.description: Model id registered on the audio.cpp server

params.name: voice
params.description: Voice id (leave blank to use the server default)

params.name: text_pattern
params.description: Regex to choose which text to speak; empty = whole message. Capture groups speak only the captured text. The double quotes ARE part of the pattern — copy `"([^"]+)"` as-is to read the text between double quotes.

params.name: max_tokens
params.description: Cap on generated audio length (0 = model default)

params.name: seed
params.description: Optional generation seed (full uint64 as a string)

params.name: unload_others
params.description: Unload other loaded models when switching (frees VRAM; off keeps multiple models resident)
